notes.title: Game Update
notes.content: [p]Thank you all for your continued support and valuable feedback! This update includes multiple optimizations to the game content, with specific adjustments as follows:[/p][h2][b]System Adjustments[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Removed the time limit from Hard Mode while increasing enemy difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed backpack treasures to have purely positive effects, which only apply to the player's party.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Town Flight item, allowing quick teleportation to previously visited towns.[/p][/*][*][p]New treasure chests will have a chance to respawn in all regions every 7 days.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Balance Optimizations[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Reduced the price of food.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly decreased the amount of health lost due to hunger.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased gold drops from bandits in the mid-to-late game.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters can now consume stat-boosting fruits.[/p][/*][*][p]Overall enhanced the stats of character equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the value of life-steal coefficients.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Combat Adjustments[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Increased the success rate of escaping battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the penalty for escaping.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-battle now retains status effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Zealots will now only appear on main roads and have an increased spawn rate.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.content: [p][b]\[New] Mutant Pet System[/b][/p][p]Now, when [b]capturing in the wild[/b] or [b]breeding pets[/b], there's a chance to obtain [b]Mutant Pets[/b]![/p][list][*][p]Mutant pets feature [b]unique appearances[/b] and naturally come with [b]2 passive skills[/b], making them even stronger in battle![/p][/*][*][p]Go explore and collect these rare mutated companions![/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Fixed] Various Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed multiple bugs affecting gameplay experience, improving combat and system stability![/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Adjusted] Pet Growth Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slightly tweaked growth curves for [b]all pets[/b], making training smoother and more balanced![/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Balanced] Skill Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced some overpowered skills to encourage more diverse combat strategies![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][i](Optional additions for context or flair:)[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]"Mutant pets have a higher chance to appear as you progress—keep exploring!"[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]"Found any issues? Let us know via \[feedback channel]!"[/i][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
[p][b]To our beloved players:[/b]
Thank you for your continuous support and love for the game! We have carefully listened to your feedback and suggestions, and hereby announce the following optimizations to enhance your gaming experience:[/p][p][b]
【Core Experience Optimizations】[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Removal of In - game Day Limit[/b]
The original day - based progression restriction has been removed, allowing players to explore the game world freely and immerse themselves in an unbound experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Pet Reproductive Ability[/b]
The pet system mechanics have been optimized to significantly improve reproductive success rates. This enables players to breed pets with combined skills more freely and efficiently cultivate super pets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced Early - Game Difficulty[/b]
The difficulty of the early gameplay has been lowered, easing the pressure of monster battles to help new players adapt more smoothly.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][p]We remain committed to delivering a better gaming experience and will continue to prioritize community feedback for future improvements. Thank you for being part of our journey—may you enjoy every moment in the game!

— The Game Development Team[/p][p]June 19, 2025[/p]

notes.title: 《森林王国的试炼》内测活动邀请函
notes.content:
亲爱的玩家/鉴赏家：

我们很高兴地宣布，一款备受期待的全新游戏《森林王国的试炼》即将开启Steam平台的EA内测活动。为了感谢您的陪伴，我们诚挚地邀请您加入这次独家测试，成为首批体验游戏的先锋玩家！  

关于游戏
这是一款融合生物收集、策略战棋和探索冒险的跨界策略RPG游戏，我们都力求打造一款能够满足您期待的精品游戏。  

内测亮点
抢先体验：在游戏正式上线前，您将有机会率先探索游戏的核心玩法与特色内容。  
专属福利：参与内测的玩家将获得稀有道具。  
深度参与：您的反馈将直接影响游戏的优化与完善，成为塑造游戏未来的重要一员。  

活动时间  
报名时间：2025年4月18日-2025年5月4日截止。


如何参与 
1. 申请资格：请点击心愿单预约后在活动帖子中简短的说明参与理由。  
2. 审核确认：我们将根据申请顺序及玩家活跃度进行筛选，并通过Steam消息或邮件通知入选玩家，请各位玩家和鉴赏家一定要记得加入心愿单哟。 
3. 加入测试：收到CDKEY，按照指引下载测试客户端，即可开启您的冒险之旅！  
 
注意事项  
- 本次内测为封闭EA测试，测试内容及数据可能与正式版有所不同。  
- 请确保您的设备符合游戏运行要求，并保持网络稳定。  
- 测试期间，请遵守游戏规则，禁止任何形式的外挂或作弊行为。  

我们深知每一位玩家的热情与期待，因此将全力以赴确保EA内测的顺利进行。无论您是资深玩家还是新晋冒险者，我们都期待您的加入！

各位游戏的鉴赏家们，我们诚邀您来体验我们的游戏，请私信或邮件我们。  
再次感谢您的支持，让我们一起见证这款作品的成长与蜕变！  
立即申请，解锁属于您的专属体验！
祝游戏愉快，
